Europe Faces Fuel Price Crisis with Varying Costs

European countries are experiencing a significant fuel price crisis, with petrol and diesel prices reaching over €2.4/L and €2.5/L respectively. While nominal prices are high across the continent, the cost of living adjusted figures reveal which nations are most severely affected. In response, the French government has announced a new €100 payment to approximately 5.5 million drivers who use their cars for work, aiming to mitigate the impact and prevent potential protests.
